data.camera: cowboy shot, stepping out from formation on dirt training field
data.description: 训练兵团的操场上，三笠在白制服外系着立体机动装置的束带，从人群中独自走出来，红围巾在风中一动不动般沉静——「训练是为了活下去。仅此而已。」
data.promptProse: Mikasa steps out from the training formation onto the dirt field while the other trainees remain in orderly rows behind her.
data.title: 三笠 · 训练兵团操场
data.animaCaption: The other trainees remain in orderly rows behind her.
